description:
Mechanical Counter Reset - Chrome Dino IRL Part 6
•••
I redesigned the score counter for my Chrome Dino game so it can reset instantly instead of counting all the way backwards. Each number wheel has a butt-shaped cam that brings it back to zero when a follower pushes against it, but getting the connecting gears to disengage and reconnect in the right order took a few iterations. The mechanism now holds the wheels at zero until the gears reconnect, then releases the followers so it’s ready to count again. I scaled it up to all five digits and added a servo to the paddle, and the original counter can still keep the high score.
